# Atlas des Schweizer Rechts / Atlas of Swiss Law

> Every federal and cantonal act of Switzerland in force (21,697 acts), the earlier federal acts (11,764),
> how each rests on another (the legal bases its preamble states), the cross-references between federal acts, and how often
> courts cite each act and article (decisions from OpenCaseLaw). Data as of 2026-10-26. By jonashertner.com. Not official:
> Fedlex and the cantons' collections are authoritative.

## Pages
- https://jonashertner.github.io/swiss-law-graph/ — the map (DE/FR/IT/EN). Links: `#<lang>/<id>` an act (`#de/220` the OR, `#de/ZH/700.1` a cantonal act,
  `#de/220:art_41` an article), `#<lang>@<year>/…` the same in a past year, `#<lang>/net`, `#<lang>/cantons/<SR>`,
  `#<lang>/check` (gaps and dead references), `#<lang>/new`, `#<lang>/method` (how every number is computed).

## Data (static files, CC0)
- https://jonashertner.github.io/swiss-law-graph/data/catalog.csv — one row per act in force (21,697); https://jonashertner.github.io/swiss-law-graph/data/catalog-earlier.csv — the earlier acts
  (11,764) and the codes courts cite that no collection holds (2,723). Columns: id, kind, jurisdiction, number, abbreviation, title_de, title_fr, title_it, title_en, level, enacted_by, adopted, from_year, until, decisions, source.
  kind: in_force | earlier (no longer in force; from_year/until its period) | not_in_collection. level: who enacted it
  (constitution, parliament, government, administration, treaty). decisions: distinct published decisions referring to it.
  source: Fedlex or the canton's page. The act on this site: https://jonashertner.github.io/swiss-law-graph/#de/<id> (fr, it, en likewise).
- https://jonashertner.github.io/swiss-law-graph/data/links.json — stated bases, co-citation and legislative cross-references between acts (indices into atlas.json).
- https://jonashertner.github.io/swiss-law-graph/data/atlas.json — the tree the map draws (meta.fields names the columns of each node).
- https://jonashertner.github.io/swiss-law-graph/feed.de.xml (also fr, it, en) — Atom feed of new federal acts in force and cantonal acts adopted.

## Full text
- https://github.com/jonashertner/swisslaw-git — the law itself as Markdown in git: every version since 2021, one commit
  per version dated on the day it applies; index.csv / index.jsonl list every file; AGENTS.md explains layout and fields.

## Code
- https://github.com/jonashertner/swiss-law-graph — the pipeline (MIT); method and every decision in its CLAUDE.md.
